subject: Vendor onboarding: Romanian e-Factura token + PO / billing entity guidance
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: TransDanube SRL Accounting <accounting@transdanube.ro>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Vendor onboarding: e-Factura registration + PO entity question

Hi Ion / accounting team,

Thanks for starting the vendor setup. Quick checklist items we need to complete to activate POs and enable automated invoice ingestion for TransDanube: 

- Proof of ANAF e-Factura registration (screenshot or export token).
- One sample invoice in both the e-Factura XML export and the PDF we receive/attach. Please include the eInvoice hash (Hash/Signature node) in the XML.
- Clarify which legal entity name and VAT (CIF) you expect Redwood to appear under on the invoice (we have Redwood Inference EMEA S.R.L. as our Romanian-facing billing entity for EU invoices).
- Flag whether the supply is "services" or "goods" (this affects reverse-charge handling).

Could you send the XML export and a PDF sample so we can validate field mappings? If possible include the original invoice language (Romanian / English) as a field.

Attaching our vendor onboarding form for EMEA billing fields — please complete section B with your VAT/CIF and the XML sample.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Procurement
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor-onboarding-form-Redwood-EMEA.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ion Popescu <ion.popescu@transdanube.ro>

Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 13:45:12 +0300
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: e-Factura registration + PO entity question

Hi Olga / Laura / Ben,

Thanks for the note. We are registered with ANAF and can provide the e-Factura export token. See attached XML (eFactura_export.xml) and a human-readable PDF (sample_invoice_20250430.pdf). A few notes from our side: 

- Our system populates the <Emitent>CIF</Emitent> and the <FacturaHash> element (see HashValue in the signature block).
- We typically mark supplies as "Servicii" (services) in Romanian. If you need an English-language description we can include both.
- For the billing entity, we usually invoice against the entity name you provide in the PO. Please confirm the exact entity name and VAT number to print; we can also include an explicit "BillToEntityID" field in the XML for PO mapping.

Attached: eFactura_export.xml (XML export with signature), sample_invoice_20250430.pdf

If you confirm Redwood Inference EMEA S.R.L. and provide the EMEA VAT (if different from the PO), we will update our template.

Regards,
Ion Popescu
Finance Manager
TransDanube SRL
[Attachment: eFactura_export.xml (application/xml)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ion Popescu <ion.popescu@transdanube.ro>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 08:02:30 +0200
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: e-Factura registration + PO entity question

Hi Ion — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of clarifications so our AP automation and PO routing work cleanly:

1) Billing entity to appear on the invoice: 
   - Redwood Inference EMEA S.R.L.
   - VAT: RO12345678 (please use this VAT when you target our EMEA PO/account).

2) Tax treatment: 
   - For the line items you labelled as "Servicii" (services), we will apply EU reverse charge where applicable. Please do not withhold Romanian VAT. Instead, include a note on the invoice: "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient under Article 196 of the EU VAT Directive / ANAF guidance".

3) XML mapping: we need the following fields populated to auto-map the invoice to a PO in our system: 
   - BillToEntityID (string) 
   - SupplierCIF / SupplierVAT (RO...)
   - eInvoiceHash / SignatureValue
   - OriginalInvoiceLanguage ("ro" or "en")

4) Invoice language: English is preferred for faster routing, but Romanian is acceptable if the XML includes an English line description field.

5) PO references: please include our PO number in the XML <NumarComanda> or <ReferenceNumber> field to avoid manual matching.

I uploaded an updated vendor form and a short mapping spec to the Doc link in my signature — if you can return the completed form and a corrected XML sample (with BillToEntityID set to "REDWOOD-EMEA"), we will enable automated PO acceptance and 30-day payment terms.

Thanks — once we confirm the mapping our AP system will process invoices automatically.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
[Related: https://redwood-corp.atlassian.net/browse/PO-4821]

Ben / Olga — good, thanks for the guidance. We'll do the following this morning:

- Regenerate the XML and set BillToEntityID = "REDWOOD-EMEA" and include the PO reference in <ReferenceNumber>.
- Add an English <ItemDescription_en> field in the XML for each line to speed your review.
- Add invoice note: "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient" as requested; we will not withhold VAT.

I'll send the amended XML and the completed onboarding form shortly. Quick question: do you require a separate WHT (withholding) statement for cross-border supplier payments from Romania to Ireland/UK/US? Our treasury sometimes asks whether to apply any local withholding.

Regards,
Ion
